chapters.title: AT THE PUT WALL
chapters.text: The bar fell to Put Wall 26505.00 and closed back above it at 26507.50. Put Wall is the strike with the most negative net gamma.

chapters.title: AT THE GAMMA FLIP
chapters.text: The bar rose to Gamma Flip 26570.25 and closed back below it at 26568.50. Gamma Flip is the net-gamma sign change nearest spot. Its caption reads price below: negative gamma, where by convention hedging amplifies moves.
